replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Hello,

"i didn't receive any warning by any moderators, he just banned me..."
1) There is no point warning you if you break the rules. You purposely spleefed a member of your team and therefore there is no point in warning you if you break the rules. I was simply doing my job and there was no need to warn you for your behavior before kicking you.
2) I didn't ban you.. I kicked you there is a difference...

" it was my 1st time spleefing (yes i did it 3 times but at that time i didn't know) and i thought u were allowed.. at least warn me once and tell me that it is not ok..."
Admitting to breaking the rules doesn't help your case. Regardless whether it was the first or tenth time you've spleefed someone, moderators usually kick teamspleefers. There are rarely situations where we warn players for this offence. Why would you think killing members of your team would be OK? It's common sense not to kill members of your own team..
Chat punishments differ from other punishments such as team spleefing. We don't warn players for hacking and ask them nicely not to do it again, no, we straight-up ban them.

Seeing as this punishment is valid and therefor just, this appeal is Denied. You clearly broke the rules and therefore your kick shall remain as a fair punishment.

Of course, if you disagree on the outcome of this appeal, let me know down below and this will be escalated to a staff member in a higher position than myself.

Have a good day.
Regards,
Cammy
Avicus Moderator
